english.note: This is the all-purpose possessive used before a noun to mean belonging to him.
This is the all-purpose spoken Cantonese equivalent for something belonging to it.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 wan2 dou2 keoi5 ge3 ngan4 baau1 laa3

examples.english: The camera got smashed, and even its lens cracked.
examples.traditional: 呢部相機跌爛咗，連佢嘅鏡頭都裂埋。
examples.jyutping: ni1 bou6 soeng1 gei1 dit3 laan6 zo2 lin4 keoi5 ge3 geng3 tau4 dou1 lit6 maai4
